description: Return registered LLM session ledger ingest sources joined with their plugin descriptors. Each result entry carries both the descriptor surface (source_kind, vendor, supported_modes, default_lease_ttl_seconds, default_pulling_root_uri) AND the session_ledger__source DB-row surface (source_id, root_uri, account_label, enabled, config_json) when both exist. Three shapes appear in the output list: (a) loaded plugin + registered DB row → all fields populated; (b) loaded plugin, no row registered → descriptor fields populated, DB fields null (operator sees what could be registered via register_source); (c) registered DB row, plugin not loaded → DB fields populated, descriptor fields null (operator sees orphaned rows whose plugins have been unloaded). The verb's job is to surface both sides of the registry so peers can answer 'which sources is this solet actually ingesting from' without writing raw SQL against session_ledger__source. Pair with register_source to register a new source and trigger_poll to fire one polling pass across all enabled sources.
embedding_description: List LLM session ledger ingest sources — DB rows joined with loaded plugin descriptors by source_kind. Each entry: descriptor fields (source_kind, vendor, supported_modes, default_lease_ttl_seconds, default_pulling_root_uri) + __source DB fields (source_id, root_uri, account_label, enabled, config_json). Loaded with no row surface descriptor-only; registered with no plugin surface DB-only.
